newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-HUNGARY LOOK FOR WIN AGAINST IN-FORM NORWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HUNGARY LOOK FOR WIN AGAINST IN-FORM NORWAY.

text.p: Hungary face Norway in Sunday's Group Two World Cup qualifier knowing they have to win to have any chance of staying in the hunt for qualification for the finals in France next year.
Norway lead the group and currently have their tails up after last week beating a Brazil side including Renaldo and Romario in a friendly in Oslo.

Following April's defeat against second-placed Switzerland Hungarian coach Janos Csank has made it clear he will be going for all out attack, and has spent much of this week's training sessions on forward skills, especially heading.

Injury worries over star midfielder Gabor Halmai, of new Hungarian cup and league double winners MTK, disappeared after Halmai's first session of full training on Wednesday and, with the exception of the Belgian club Anderlecht's suspended new signing Florian Urban, Csank can count on a full squad,
The team thrashed second division team Komarom 9-1 on Thursday afternoon and the final line-up is likely to be announced on Saturday.
